title: Web server OOM kill without restart
reason: The engineer correctly identified the web container, the OOM‑kill crash, and the memory‑limit exceed as the triggering cause.
option_titles: Increase web memory limit and restart
Raise web memory limit to 1024 MiB and restart
root_cause: The nginx web container was terminated by the Linux OOM killer after exceeding its 256 MiB memory limit, as shown by exit code 137 and the container being stopped while no application errors appear.
truth: The web container was killed by the OOM killer due to a temporary memory spike, and because it has no restart policy, it remained stopped.
